scientific_integrity: The plane-curve equations and cusp are due to Kollár. Previously determined geometric-point and tangent stabilizers are not claimed as new. Only the explicit higher-order semidirect subgroup and quantitative length statement are new. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The constructed finite subgroup has exact length \(q^3(q+1)\), but equality with the full stabilizer, its complete identity-component equations, and its total length are not asserted. Earlier determinations of geometric points and Lie dimension are credited; this work adds a higher-order scheme subgroup. Computational examples do not replace the proof; possible unindexed literature overlap remains.
title: A uniform higher-order infinitesimal subgroup in the Kollár cusp stabilizers
